System design — category 2

Consistency in distributed systems is one of the three pilot topics, so this is the category a real learner will actually meet in September. Maths is not in the pilot at all.

Two genuinely new blocks out of nine: a graph as the answer, and a number with a tolerance. Everything else is the code category pointed at different pixels — which is the test of whether the block abstraction was worth building.

Static mockups, matching the learnos canvas.

The honest cost

Code and maths render in the generator worker and ship no library to the browser. This category breaks that: a diagram the learner drags nodes around has to be live, so React Flow ships.

Mitigated, not avoided — lazy, one screen, never in the extension, and a concept taught with graphBuild comes back on day 8 as a hotspot on a flat SVG. The heavy screen is where a concept is learned, not where it is kept.
